title: Domosenso catalog category: what a device is for, for every component that sorts, colours or filters devices (SPEC-028 Amendment 5)

order.description: Lower is tried first; the first category that matches a device wins.

placeable.description: false: things that move (phones, tags); never a point on a plan.

fallback.description: The one category for a device that matched nothing.

hub.description: true: a device other enabled devices name as via_device_id is in this category.

extra_role.description: true: a device in another category that also matches this one has it as a further role (what it senses: presence, climate).

kinds.description: Ids under kinds/: a device their match rules recognise is in this category.

rule.description: SPEC-010's device rule (every field given must match; globs are case-insensitive) without `entry`, plus only_entity_domain and marker.

extra_role.description: This rule gives the category, never a further role (an appliance's door is no presence).
